note: The role families Aria is weighing, and what she wants from the next job. Each requirement lists the words postings use for it. Edit this file for your own search; nothing here is real.

roles.title: AI Enablement Lead
roles.summary: AI enablement lead who gets AI ideas to working prototypes fast, sorts real AI work from everything else, and helps teams keep going on their own.

requirements.need: Gets AI ideas to a working prototype fast
Runs training or workshops that change how people work
Works with leadership on AI priorities
Sorts demand and says no to what isn't AI

roles.title: AI Adoption Product Manager
roles.summary: Product manager for AI adoption: runs intake, ships prototypes with the teams that asked, and is honest about what the numbers do and don't show.

requirements.need: Owns intake and triage of AI requests
Ships prototypes with the requesting team
Sets accuracy targets and reads model results
Works with data teams on data quality

roles.title: Service Design Lead
roles.summary: Service designer who redesigns the moments people wait, measures the change, and brings AI in where it helps.

requirements.need: Redesigns a service end to end
Measures the experience before and after
Gets ideas in front of people early
